text: I bought the new edition of that English book.
translation: 我买了那本英语书的新版。
note: 同一本书的新版 = 版本。

text: This is the third edition of the same work.
translation: 这是同一作品的第三个版本。

text: The new edition has much more useful data.
translation: 新版多了很多有用的数据。
note: 更新后的版本 = 版本。

text: She read the latest edition of the paper on the train.
translation: 她在火车上读了这份论文的最新版本。

text: We printed a cheap edition for the students.
translation: 我们给学生印了一版便宜的。
note: 一次印刷的版本 = 版。

text: The first edition of that book came out in 1990.
translation: 那本书的第一版出版于 1990 年。

text: This edition is smaller but costs the same.
translation: 这一版更小，但价钱一样。
note: 同样是纸本上的版 = 版。

text: The paper came out in a revised edition last month.
translation: 这篇论文上个月出了修订版。
note: 修订后印的一版 = 版。

text: His answer was only an edition of what I said.
translation: 他的回答不过是我所说的话的翻版。
note: edition of = 翻版（雷同的说法）。

text: The two paintings are an edition of the same design.
translation: 这两幅画是同一设计的翻版。
note: 同一设计的复制品 = 翻版。

text: His book seems an edition of his sister's.
translation: 他的书看起来是他姐姐那本的翻版。

text: That new game is just an edition of an old one.
translation: 那个新游戏不过是老游戏的翻版。
note: 缺乏新意的复制 = 翻版。

text: This edition has notes on every page.
Ten thousand copies of this edition were sold.
The final scene is an edition of the first one.
translation: 最后一幕是第一幕的翻版。
